verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance and entity-management software and service provider, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has only two robots.txt probes: one host returned a Cloudflare challenge and the other redirects into it. Neither says anything about a self-hosted or on-premises deployment, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
